tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The 60 of the 60-30-10 palette: page backgrounds, cards, form fields. Also the label colour on navy fills.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: The 30: alternating sections, highlights, bullets, check discs, the featured-plan badge and the button on navy. Never text on white (1.35:1); navy on sky reads at 11.7:1.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: The 10: all text, primary buttons, the footer and CTA band, key icons, the focus ring. 15.7:1 on white, 11.7:1 on sky.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Resolved from color-mix(in srgb, sky 35%, white). Hover fill for secondary buttons, eyebrow pills, Evry's speech bubble, the FAQ plus disc.

tokens.name: sky-mist
tokens.usage: Resolved from color-mix(in srgb, sky 18%, white). The faintest tint: the 'mist' section tone, FAQ summary hover, the suggestion panel in the hero mockup.

tokens.name: navy-soft
tokens.usage: Resolved from color-mix(in srgb, navy 88%, sky). Primary button hover only.

tokens.name: navy-80
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: lead paragraphs, card body, FAQ answers. 8.3:1 on white, 6.8:1 on sky.

tokens.name: navy-75
tokens.usage: The lightest text allowed: captions, price periods, '(optional)' hints. 7.0:1 on white, 5.9:1 on sky. Never go lighter for text.

tokens.name: navy-60
tokens.usage: Form placeholder text only. 4.27:1 on white: below AA 4.5:1 as the source has it; flagged, keep placeholders as hints and never as the only label.

tokens.name: navy-40
tokens.usage: Dashed border of the placeholder tag.

tokens.name: navy-30
tokens.usage: Resting underline of text links (turns full navy on hover).

tokens.name: navy-28
tokens.usage: Secondary button border on hover.

tokens.name: navy-20
tokens.usage: Resting border of text fields and selects (1.5:1 on white: below the 3:1 control-border floor in the source; the field turns full navy on focus and on error).

tokens.name: navy-16
tokens.usage: Secondary button border at rest. Also the 15% ring on small 'Not now' chips.

tokens.name: navy-08
tokens.usage: Card hairline border.

tokens.name: white-85
tokens.usage: Body copy on navy (CTA band, featured plan). 11.7:1 on navy.

tokens.name: white-80
tokens.usage: Muted text on navy (price period on the featured plan). 10.5:1 on navy.

tokens.name: white-60
tokens.usage: Ghost-light button border on hover.

tokens.name: white-35
tokens.usage: Ghost-light button border at rest, on navy.

tokens.name: white-10
tokens.usage: Ghost-light button hover fill, on navy.

tokens.name: sky-glow
tokens.usage: Centre of the soft radial glow behind the hero (fades to sky at 0). On the navy CTA band the same glow runs at 0.16.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Alias: the page background.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Alias: default text colour on white, sky, sky-soft and sky-mist.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Alias: 3px solid outline, 3px offset, on every light surface.

tokens.name: focus-ring-on-navy
tokens.usage: Alias: the focus ring inside navy areas (.on-navy). 11.7:1 on navy.

styles.name: text-display
styles.usage: The page's one h1. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 1.8rem + 3vw, 4.5rem), 40px at 375px wide to 72px at 1440px.

styles.name: text-h2
styles.usage: Section headings and the CTA band. Fluid: clamp(2rem, 1.65rem + 1.5vw, 3rem), 32px to 48px.

styles.name: text-h3
styles.usage: Card and plan titles, h2 inside blog posts. Fluid: clamp(1.375rem, 1.24rem + 0.56vw, 1.75rem), 22px to 28px.

styles.name: text-title
styles.usage: Small titles inside cards and tool tiles.

styles.name: text-lead
styles.sample: Tasks, habits, notes, and your calendar live together in Evry.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a heading, in navy-80. Fluid: clamp(1.125rem, 1.08rem + 0.2vw, 1.25rem), 18px to 20px.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Build routines at your own pace.
styles.usage: All running text. Bold (700) for labels, FAQ questions and button text.

styles.name: text-bubble
styles.sample: I found a free slot at 2:00 for “Write report.” Add it?
styles.usage: Speech bubbles (EvryBubble md). The sm bubble is 13px / 1.375.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: Eyebrows, field errors, the small print under pricing (at 400).

styles.name: text-wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the plain mark in the header and footer. Always the word Evry, capital E.

styles.name: text-price
styles.usage: Plan prices, followed by the period in 16px 600 navy-75.

tokens.name: space-container
tokens.usage: max-width of .container-page (76rem). Also the CTA band's max width.

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: Page side padding below 768px.

tokens.name: space-gutter-md
tokens.usage: Page side padding from 768px.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every Section (.section-y) below 1024px.

tokens.name: space-section-lg
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of every Section from 1024px.

tokens.name: space-heading
tokens.usage: Gap under a SectionHeading (56px from 1024px).

tokens.name: space-grid
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid, and between form rows.

tokens.name: space-card
tokens.usage: Inner padding of plan cards (36px from 640px). Forms: 24px, 36px from 640px.

tokens.name: space-btn-x
tokens.usage: Button side padding.

tokens.name: space-btn-y
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-btn-height
tokens.usage: Minimum button height.

tokens.name: space-tap
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target anywhere (header logo, nav links). Checked by check:widths.

tokens.name: space-store-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an app store button and FAQ summary row.

tokens.name: space-scroll-offset
tokens.usage: scroll-padding-top, so anchors clear the sticky header.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, eyebrows, badges, chips, placeholder tags, bullets.

tokens.name: radius-band
tokens.usage: The navy CTA band.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Plan cards and other large panels.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, FAQ items, forms, blog covers.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Text fields, selects, store buttons, speech bubbles, inset panels (rounded-2xl).

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Tool icon tiles (rounded-xl). The Notes tile cuts its top-right corner to 5.6px.

tokens.name: radius-focus
tokens.usage: Corner of the focus outline.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The speech-bubble corner that points at the speaker (bottom-left for Evry, bottom-right for you).

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Resting card.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered card, open FAQ item, featured plan.

tokens.name: shadow-device
tokens.usage: Phone mockups.

tokens.name: shadow-btn
tokens.usage: Primary button at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-btn-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button on hover.

tokens.name: shadow-mascot
tokens.usage: Applied as filter: drop-shadow() under the floating hero mascot, so it follows the star's outline.

tokens.name: duration-hover
tokens.usage: Buttons and links: transform, shadow, colour.

tokens.name: duration-card
tokens.usage: Card lift on hover.

tokens.name: duration-pop
tokens.usage: Items popping in (week plan, tools, Meet Evry).

tokens.name: duration-reveal

tokens.name: duration-float

tokens.name: duration-blink
tokens.usage: The mascot's blink loop.

tokens.usage: The house curve: reveals, pops, demo transitions. Fast out, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-spring
tokens.usage: Playful overshoot: mascot tilt, squish, hints.

tokens.name: ease-bounce
tokens.usage: Rating stars' hover bump.
